set.body:
PRD G-11/G-11a; preserve owner decisions q-scope and k-framecheck. No design.Session exists. EyeLinkAscSession and DocumentIdentities solve different problems and do not satisfy this ticket. Implement the first checked scientific container in eyes4s-design, which can see Recording, AoiSet and Grid; no GUI/storage/project service and no dependency from design to plan/codec/effects.

Bounded first slice: immutable Session[U] with a declared frame and clock, private construction and Either-returning admission/replacement of keyed recordings, AOI sets and grids. Clock-bearing values must agree with the declared clock; purely spatial values require frame agreement only. All compatibility goes through Agreement, including reused nominal IDs with conflicting specifications. No automatic warp, synchronization, resampling or identity rewrite. Define duplicate-key/replacement/removal behavior, stable iteration and empty-container/AOI handling explicitly; failed changes leave the original container unchanged.

Total access means a missing key returns Option or a typed absence, never apply/throw/null and never a forged handle authorizing unrelated objects. Successful access returns the stored checked object without rechecking compatibility. Do not introduce Scope, ambient evidence, unchecked public constructors, heterogeneous Any tables or object-identity-based membership. A handle, if used, must be impossible to reuse against another session without checking; the simple Option lookup is sufficient for this slice.

Acceptance: public construction/insertion/replacement/removal/access tests; same unit with different frame ID, same ID with conflicting bounds/axes, wrong clocks, duplicate/missing keys, empty sets, and retained valid state after refusal. External-package mutation/aliasing and forged-access attempts cannot invalidate admitted invariants; compile-time claims have typeCheckErrors. Laws/conformance demonstrate every admitted value has the declared identities on JVM/JS; targeted admission-bypass mutant must fail. plan's app-prereq owns the adapter from Session to existing Preflight and epoch availability queries, avoiding a design-to-plan cycle. Persistence is not required to establish this container.

Dependencies aoi-set and x-trials are already closed; this bounded slice is actionable. Review: docs/TRACKER_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md.
set.title: Session: checked container with total accessors
